scope: Isolated forward trials by fresh evaluators given a copy of the package (and change-sequencing for github-issues) and fixtures, without expected outcomes; one metadata-only routing round across three suites; author review against completion criteria.

trials.note: Behavior-grouped Changes, outage-grounded Summary, Impact flags the changed error after max_attempts, Verification states no run record instead of carrying over "tests: passed", Closes #41, attribution lines removed. Read SKILL.md and pr-description.md only.
Conventional subject, explanatory body wrapped at 72, Signed-off-by for the human committer, no Co-Authored-By. Read SKILL.md only.

Returned only pr_title and pr_description from SKILL.md alone; Closes #41 because base equals default; verification lists only the provided pytest result and states what was not run; no commands or attribution.

post_trial_changes: After review: SKILL.md linked-issue rule keeps partially resolved issues open and closes stacked-change issues only once the change reaches the default branch or meets the release convention; squash-merge subject qualified by repository settings (GitHub's default uses a single commit's own message); references/writing-to-git.md uses the operation's --continue for in-progress merges, cherry-picks, and reverts (a reproduced two-commit cherry-pick was left half applied by git commit --no-edit) and updates only an OPEN PR; references/commit-message.md squash section qualified. The trials above ran on the earlier hashes in skill_sha256 and do not carry over to these revisions.

Second review: references/writing-to-git.md runs each --continue with GIT_EDITOR=true, because --continue opens an editor that stalls or fails without a terminal. GIT_EDITOR=true was chosen over -c core.editor=true because a GIT_EDITOR already set in the environment overrides core.editor (reproduced: the merge stayed unfinished).
limits: One evaluator per case, same model family as the author; no comparison with an agent without the skill; no live GitHub writes. Results do not carry over to revised file hashes.
